query: SELECT cm.id, cm.title, cm.path, COUNT(qq.id) as quiz_count FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN quiz_questions qq ON qq.moduleId = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id, cm.title, cm.path ORDER BY cm.id;
